name: story-slider
description: Customer-story slider: quote copy beside a large photo or video, with arrows, a progress rule, dots and a view-all link below. Live: #ap-*-case on the product pages (apc-*) and #ap-gov-case on the industry hubs.

variant.description: home: the homepage slider's taller logo plate and compact twelve-dot controls on phones. solution: the September 2026 solution pages' smaller story titles. eduhub: the Education hub (live #ap-eduhub-case: 48px band spacing on phones from the page sheet).

stack.description: Width below which a slide stacks: narrow 900px (product pages, Education hub, Emergency Preparedness, School Reunification); wide 1180px (the other hubs, Help Desk and the September solution pages).

items.description: Slides. Each: quote (required, except on a video slide that has a title — the video then carries the story); optional category (small label above the title), title, author, role (line breaks kept), image, image_alt, logo, logo_alt, logo_w, logo_h, logo_text (a wordmark instead of a logo image; wrap the bold part in *asterisks*), logo_style (hospice|osage|fresenius), link_label, link_url, video_id (YouTube), video_start, video_end, video_title. A video slide shows its logo / logo_text on the poster until the player loads.

quote_icon.description: Quote mark image URL. Empty uses the kit's orange mark.

viewall_label.description: Link beside the controls. Renders only with viewall_url.
